written.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Collection Now at the Rockstar Store - Rockstar Games
written.description: What Rockstar Newswire reported on 8 October 2026: "Grand Theft Auto VI Collection Now at the Rockstar Store - Rockstar Games", in their own words.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Grand Theft Auto VI, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## Rockstar Newswire, 8 October 2026

[Grand Theft Auto VI Collection Now at the Rockstar Store - Rockstar Games](https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/759875393o5253/grand-theft-auto-vi-collection-now-at-the-rockstar-store)

The outlet's own summary:

> Presenting the official Grand Theft Auto VI Collection, featuring new apparel and collectibles inspired by Grand Theft Auto VI, exclusively available now at the Rockstar Store.

> Please note that if you turn off some types of Cookies, it may limit your experience on the Site and the services we are able to offer.

> Grand Theft Auto VI Goodtime State and Macca the Gator Tees Get your own piece of Goodtime State Gear, inspired by the styles seen on Jason and Lucia in the Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition , with these tees featuring characters from Leonida’s hit TV show Macca the Gator.

> The chrome two-sided Grand Theft Auto VI – Vice City Money Clip features a blind embossed classic Vice City logo on one side and the VI logo with palm trees on the other.

> There’s also a refillable, polished chrome Grand Theft Auto VI – Vice City Zippo® Lighter , heavy duty canvas tote bags, and two sets of vinyl stickers.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
